title: ChatRequest
description: Body of POST /api/chat (console/api.js -> chat.mts). Plain-text turns only: the browser never sends tool_use, tool_result or thinking blocks (agent-console-security). Turn order (user first, alternating, user last: no prefill) is checked in code, not here. Size rules the schema cannot express are enforced in code BEFORE JSON.parse: whole body <= 64 KB (secure-by-design), last user message <= SETTINGS.perTurn.maxUserMessageBytes (32 KB, UTF-8 bytes). The client drops the oldest user/assistant pairs to stay under 64 KB. Contract: docs/design/build-contracts.md §5.
